environment: Repository-native Stage 10 G-P10 human-decision recording, exact-package verification, and feedback.strategy handoff evidence for task.skillcertify.10.014
constraints: Task scope is limited to recording the already-authorized human G-P10 decision and its feedback.strategy handoff evidence.
The G-P10 PASS decision derives solely from the explicit human decision source bound to package.skillcertify.g-p10.v1 and its exact approved digest.
G-P10 PASS unlocks feedback.strategy only; it does not itself modify Strategy or WIP.
No automatic next-cycle execution, ClinicFlow/POC startup, new-product startup, or other downstream execution is authorized.
No automatic publication or public-safe classification is authorized.
Git staging, commit, push, pull request, merge, and any further persistence require their own explicit authorization.
Canonical registries must not be mutated without a separately proven transition mechanism and explicit authorization.

alternatives.rationale: No external tool is required to serialize deterministic JSON, calculate SHA-256, verify local evidence refs, or enforce the explicit governance boundary.

selection_rationale: Task 10.014 is a bounded decision-recording and feedback.strategy handoff task; AI/tool use is limited to evidence preparation, factual consistency checks, contract interpretation, and deterministic documentation support.
The human decision source is the sole authority for the G-P10 PASS decision; the selected AI/tool has no gate-decision authority.

The execution boundary prohibits automatic Strategy/WIP changes, automatic next-cycle execution, ClinicFlow/POC startup, new-product startup, automatic publication, or unapproved Git/external actions.
risks: A recorded G-P10 PASS could be incorrectly interpreted as authority to mutate Strategy/WIP or start a subsequent cycle.
The feedback.strategy handoff could be incorrectly interpreted as an executed Strategy write rather than an advisory handoff.
This AI/tool-selection sidecar could be incorrectly treated as decision authority even though the human decision source is authoritative.
Canonical task or gate registries could be mutated by inference despite no proven transition mechanism authorizing such synchronization.
human_controls: The human decision source is the sole authority for the G-P10 PASS decision.
The exact package reference and digest must remain bound to the human decision record.
feedback.strategy is unlocked only as an advisory handoff; Strategy/WIP changes require separate authorization.
Next-cycle execution, ClinicFlow/POC, publication, registries, and other downstream mutations require separate explicit authorization.
Every Git staging, commit, push, pull request, or merge action requires its own bounded authorization.
review_due: on material environment/tool change or before future reuse
curation_source: CP10-014-C through CP10-014-Q canonical contract harvest, human-decision materialization, exact-byte publication verification, and post-push closure reconciliation
